sources_considered.why: Dated primary disclosure describing costs and delays associated with safeguards and restricted research.
Dated primary measurements describe compute reassignment during restrictions.
Primary announcement shows that infrastructure serves deployment and customer inference as well as training.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI reports costs and delays from implementing safeguards. This supports the narrower possibility of commercial friction, but does not isolate the cost of slower development or establish industry-wide financial incompatibility.

evidence_items.locator: Section 4: Pacing model development; paragraph describing the week following August 7
evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI reports that allocation to other model classes largely offset the restricted model's decline. This challenges an automatic link between a targeted training restriction and falling compute use, but does not establish the effects of a broad, sustained slowdown.

evidence_items.locator: Infrastructure at scale; paragraph beginning 'Significant Trainium2 capacity'
evidence_items.explanation: The announced infrastructure expansion includes serving Claude through Bedrock. Customer deployment provides a demand channel distinct from frontier training, although this announcement does not establish its sufficiency to sustain financial obligations during a slowdown.

unresolved_gaps: The available disclosures do not quantify the net financial effect of a defined industry slowdown.
The records do not establish how binding payments, financing conditions, and customer demand would interact during such a slowdown.
The measured restriction was targeted and temporary, not an industry-wide test.
